snippet.title: No Man's Sky 10th Anniversary Trailer
snippet.description: On August 9th 2016 the first Travellers set foot on their first planet in No Man's Sky. 10 years on and over 40 major (free) updates later, and the universe is more bustling and vibrant than ever.
